exposure: uterine interventions (manual removal of placenta, assisted procedures)
cohort: The study included 1,400 patients who delivered between 2019 and 2023.
finding: The study identified instrumental and cesarean deliveries, along with uterine interventions, as crucial risk factors for postpartum hemorrhagic complications, highlighting disparities in healthcare access for rural patients.
mod_finding: Instrumental and cesarean deliveries were associated with an increased risk of postpartum hemorrhagic complications.
